description: Welcome to Encino Oaks! This is a great opportunity to own in the highly desirable Encino Oaks community. This well-located unit features a functional floor plan with a spacious living area and a private balcony perfect for relaxing or enjoying fresh air. The gated community offers resort-style amenities, including a sparkling pool and spa, fitness center, recreation room, tennis courts, and beautifully landscaped grounds with tranquil pathways and green spaces. Ideally situated just minutes from Ventura Boulevard, you'll enjoy easy access to popular restaurants, shopping, entertainment, and the 101 Freeway, making commuting and daily errands convenient. Perfect for owner-occupants or investors, this unit offers excellent potential in one of Encino's most sought-after communities.
